description: This image presents a 2x2 grid of four pie charts comparing the distribution of response categories across four different language models, labeled "GPT4-o", "Gemini1.5-Pro", "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct", and "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct". None of the slices are visually emphasized through exploding, offsetting, or bolding, and the segments do not appear to follow a strict size-based ordering. The top-right chart for "Gemini1.5-Pro" displays five slices: a medium brown slice for "Misinformation" at 33 (38.4%), a dark blue-grey slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 19 (22.1%), a medium blue-grey slice for "Ethical Advice" at 14 (16.3%), an olive green slice for "Clarification" at 12 (14.0%), and a dark red slice for "Safety" at 8 (9.3%). The bottom-left chart for "Llama3.1-70B-Instruct" consists of two slices: a light brown slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 3 (75.0%) and a dark red slice for "Clarification" at 1 (25.0%). Finally, the bottom-right chart for "Llama3.1-405B-Instruct" is divided into two equal slices: a dark red slice for "Misinformation" at 2 (50.0%) and a light brown slice for "Lack of Knowledge" at 2 (50.0%).
